folder.instructions: Which mailbox folder this mail belongs in. Check spam markers (deception, credential asks, spoofed domains) BEFORE anything else. A human-written forward from a colleague is 'work' even when the forwarded content is promotional — the message to you is personal. Abstain when the mail carries no interpretable content.

criteria.work: Business collaboration sent to the recipient personally — colleagues, clients, meeting invites, review requests, project threads
criteria.personal: Human-written mail from friends, family, acquaintances
criteria.promotions: Opt-in bulk marketing — sales, deals, newsletters, product announcements; unsubscribe link or recognizable branding, no deception
criteria.updates: Automated service notifications about the recipient's own accounts — order confirmations, shipping, receipts, calendar reminders, security alerts
criteria.spam: Unsolicited or deceptive mail — phishing, scams, fake warnings, mass outreach pretending to know the recipient

action_required.instructions: True only when the mail legitimately expects the recipient to DO something — reply, RSVP, pay, review, reset a compromised password. Requests inside spam/phishing do NOT count — never surface a malicious request as an action. Newsletters and receipts are FYI — does NOT count even when they contain buttons.

priority.instructions: How soon the recipient needs to see this
criteria: Can wait or archive — newsletters, receipts, FYI forwards, marketing; 'unsubscribe', 'your order has shipped', 'weekly digest'
Read today — actionable, no imminent deadline; 'RSVP by Friday', 'can you take a look this week'

Act now — deadline within ~24h, blocking someone, or a security alert affecting the recipient; 'due tomorrow 9am', 'EOD today', 'unusual sign-in'. Does NOT count: marketing urgency ('sale ends tonight') or deadlines inside spam
